title: Part Fourteen: The Ledger: Syria, Iran, Iraq, Yemen and the Neighbours

sections.brief: Syria: the 2013–24 strike campaign (Netanyahu/Eisenkot 2019; Damascus consulate 2024), Airwars' provisional civilian estimate vs IDF zero; ~480 strikes Dec 2024; SOHR's 460 incursions in 2025; Sweida July 2025 (SOHR 1,311 dead by party, 15 killed by Israeli strikes) with Israel's and Syria's stated positions; no displacement figure found; status Oct 2026 (link gi9_syria). Figure: stats

Iran: no territorial claim; June 2025 tolls by counting body (Health Ministry, Foundation of Martyrs, HRANA; 28 dead in Israel), Evin prison; 2026 tolls (Iranian government, Health Ministry via UN, HRANA; Minab by US Tomahawks; 24–28 in Israel), UN-relayed infrastructure damage and 3.2m relocated; status Oct 2026. Figure: compare

Iraq: 2019 PMF depot strikes, US officials' confirmation, Netanyahu's statements, no strike found since; Yemen: Houthi fire and Israeli strikes Jul 2024–Sep 2025 with Houthi-ministry tolls, CPJ's 31 journalists, no consolidated count, 2026 status. Figure: timeline

Egypt (Rafah seizure and reopenings, displacement red line, Suez losses, gas deal and Sinai treaty strain) and Jordan (not attacked; airspace, Tower 22, IMF and 2026 tourism and gas effects, 'alternative homeland'); closing ledger table for all nine theatres of Parts 13–14 with toll, displaced, stated reason and status; labelled argument on permanence.
